review.en: The Gifford Lectures given at Edinburgh by an American psychologist and philosopher, studying religion as personal experience rather than doctrine: conversion, saintliness, mysticism, the sick soul and the healthy-minded. James quotes his witnesses at length and judges them by their fruits in life. It founded the psychology of religion and remains generous, curious and readable.
review.zh: 美国心理学家、哲学家詹姆斯在爱丁堡所作的吉福德讲座。他把宗教当作个人经验而不是教义来研究：皈依、圣徒性、神秘主义、病态的灵魂与健全的心态。他大段引用见证者的自述，并以其在生活中结出的果实来衡量。此书开创了宗教心理学，至今读来宽厚、好奇而流畅。
